it.t: Jade is a stacking Buff which grants 1% additional Physical Damage Reduction per stack. Maximum of 10 Jade stacks.

Sealed Skills are skills which gain Seals. Only skills you use yourself can be Sealed. When you use a Sealed Skill, its Seals are broken, and that use of the skill will gain some benefit based on how many Seals it had.
A Strike is a Melee attack that directly hits with weapons or body parts. Slam attacks do not count as Strikes.
Invoked Skills are those Triggered by Invocation Skills.
These are Augments which have powerful singular effects, but are more limited. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.

There are three types of Citadels, each located in different cities throughout Wraeclast. Copper Citadels in Faridun Cities, Iron Citadels in Ezomyte Cities and Stone Citadels in Vaal Cities. Complete one of each type of Citadel and collect their Crisis Fragments to gain access to The Burning Monolith.

Affinity is a buff granted by the Trinity skill. There are three types of Affinity: Fire, Cold and Lightning. You can have a maximum of 100 of each type of Affinity. You lose 10 Affinity per second of specific types if you haven't gained Affinity of that type in the past 8 seconds.

it.t: Unarmed Damage refers to the Hit Damage of Unarmed Attacks. As such, Unarmed Damage is always Attack Hit Damage. Players' base Unarmed Damage is Physical, and has a minimum roll of 2, and a maximum roll between 5 - 8, depending on how aligned their class is with Strength. Other Damage is not considered Unarmed Damage, even if you are Unarmed while dealing it.
Legacy of Diamond is a Mage's Legacy which grants 75% increased Critical Hit Chance.

A higher Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it less likely that being Hit by Elemental Damage will apply the relevant Ailment, as well as lowering the amount of Freeze and Electrocute buildup recieved. A lower Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it more likely, and increases buildup of Freeze and Electrocute recieved. By default a player's Ailment Threshold is equal to half their Life.
